- Tue 2/17 15:00–15:30
- Wed 2/18 09:00–09:30

If none of the above work, feel free to pick a slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m.

Hi Sophie — great to meet you, and thanks for the quick reply. We’ll take the Tue 2/17 15:00 PST slot. I’m attaching a calendar invite and a short agenda so your infra lead knows what to expect.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m Hosted API demo: latency/cost controls and streaming
- 10m integration questions (sample prompts, auth, keys, SDKs)
- 5m next steps & trial support (credits, eval checklist)

Quick answers to your question on billing: Hosted API is usage-based (per-token) and we publish unit prices in the console. For evaluation — and depending on expected token volumes — we commonly recommend a short reserved window or trial credits to keep costs predictable. I put a one-page note in the attached quickstart.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.ics, hosted-api-quickstart.pdf

If the infra lead wants deeper performance numbers (p50/p95 latency on specific models/seq lengths), Monica can bring bench results or we can share model profiles ahead of time.

See you Tuesday.
